text:
lena.m: Quick sync: launching a staggered-discount experiment for commercial customers next week. Plan: tier1 -5%, tier2 -7.5%, tier3 -10% over a 30d trial window. Need ops checklist: invoicing notes, prorations, grandfathering, and vendor pass-through.

paul.v: Clarify grandfathering: customers with grandfathering=true should not enter experiment. Is that tag authoritative or do we need an explicit opt-out list?

lena.m: Use customer.metadata.grandfathering=true as primary block. Secondary opt-out list in drive (shared sheet). Sales can request exceptions via SFDC tag "stagger-exempt".

iris.o: For invoices: we should add invoice.metadata.experiment="staggered_discount_july" and invoice.line.note="Trial discount applied". Also need a process for issuing credit memos for mid-cycle trials if net_due decreases.

matthew.c: Schema changes proposed: invoice.metadata.experiment, invoice.metadata.experiment_variant (tier1/tier2/tier3), invoice.metadata.granted_via (auto|sfdc). Migration is light; rollback = clear flags and re-run exporter for affected window.

lena.m: Vendor pass-through: some resold credits are on a vendor rate card. If we apply discount we should not change vendor settlement amounts. Finance suggests issuing internal absorb_amount entries instead of altering vendor line. Thoughts?

paul.v: Agreed — do not mutate vendor settlement lines. Create internal accounting entry: acct_adjust.vendor_subsidy = negative to preserve vendor payout. We need GL mapping. @iris.o can you add mapping?

iris.o: Will add GL mapping: 7010 (vendor_subsidy) and 4100 (discount_recovery). Also define memo flow for credits > $1k require manager sign-off.

billing-bot: [automated] Experiment created: staggered_discount_july | cohorts=commercial_us_global | start=2026-07-08 | variants=[tier1,tier2,tier3] | id=exp_20260708_stagger

matthew.c: Monitoring: add chart daily_percent_change_by_customer, credit_memo_count, and vendor_settlement_delta. Alert if >3 customers have >15% net change OR any single customer >25k delta.

paul.v: Customer communications: Sales will send pre-notice 7 days before. For mid-cycle starts, include proration example in email and link to billing portal.

lena.m: Proration rules: start_date forces pro-rata calculation for the remainder of billing period. Add invoice.line.proration_flag=true for visibility.

iris.o: Credit memo flow: auto-generate memos for negative deltas < $1k. For >= $1k create review ticket in JIRA billing-credit with fields: customer_id, est_delta, reason, approved_by.

matthew.c: Small technical note: exporter truncates to 2 decimals; run sensitivity for rounding on tier boundaries. I'll run a limited canary export for 20 customers Thursday 08:00 PT.

lena.m: Success criteria: median percent change < 3% and <5 customers exceed 10% net delta. If thresholds hit we pause and roll back.

billing-bot: [automated] Scheduled: exp_20260708_stagger -> 1769596800 (2026-07-08 08:00:00 PT)

lena.m: Thanks team. I'll drop the exemptions sheet and the SFDC tag guide in the drive and ping legal for large-exposure sign-off. :white_check_mark:
